{{Quote|Rogue Group, we need to secure those gas storage platforms at all costs. Wipe out the Imperials in the area before we head into the city. Then our transports will be able to move in and take the gas.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />}}
The '''Raid on Bespin''' was a minor engagement by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-occupied [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The Rebel's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] engaged Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[Imperial siege balloon|siege balloons]] to secure the [[tibanna gas platform]]s and allow [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transports]] to move in and take the gas. The squadron then moved into [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to secure the remaining platforms. The Imperials launched a reprisal strike with [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]], but the Rogues shot them all down.

==Prelude==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] pressured the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], into giving them [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|friends]] with the threat of an occupation of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Shortly thereafter, the Empire reneged on its half of the bargain and [[Occupation of Bespin|conquered]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SWE5">{{Film|V}}</ref> Some time after, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which was fighting the Empire, received intelligence about a new, powerful [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. The Alliance therefore planned an [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] against the station in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> As part of the lead-up, the Alliance launched a raid against Bespin to capture valuable [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was assigned to the raid some time after their [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV]].<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

==Raid==
{{Quote|Excellent. These tibanna gas platforms are secure. Form up and head for the city.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />}}
However, the Imperials has had anticipated the Rebel's raid, and planted seven siege balloons on guard near a series of six [[tibanna gas platform]]s. The balloons were also ordered to target and destroy the platforms, preferring it to the alternative of letting the Rebels secure the tibanna gas.<ref name="RS II guide" />

Rogue Squadron, under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], was assigned to the mission to raid Bespin by securing the platforms and escorting three [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|Rebel Transports]] while they were in route to Cloud City itself. Rogue Squadron first targeted the siege balloons in order to ensure that they didn't blow up the platforms.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
By the time the Rebels arrived at the second tibanna gas platform, [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] Wedge Antilles shot down an [[Imperial tanker]], and uncovered some [[homing concussion missile]]s to which he procured, although it came at the cost of most of the tibanna gas containers on the platform.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

[[File:Raid_on_Bespin_power_gnerators.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rogue squadron attacks the power generator in Cloud City.]]

Afterward, Rogue Squadron had to deal with several [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] that were proceeding to target both the platforms and the transports. Antilles and the Rogues [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] and destroyed the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The three transports then docked with the platforms as Antilles ordered the Rogues to form up.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

A Rogue pilot spotted three main [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] in Cloud City on his [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] and suggested destroying them to weaken the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses. Antilles ordered them to destroy the generators and wished them luck. Rogue Squadron also started using [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm Iv Twin-Pod Cloud cars]] shortly before Wedge's attack on the generators. After destroying the generators, Antilles reported the objective's success and ordered the squadron to save the gas platforms. Rogue Squadron commenced with mopping up operations by destroying more siege balloons near the final two tibanna gas platforms, as well as destroying a newly-dispatched [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] squadron.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The tibanna gas is ours. Great job! Rebel transports, you're clear for approach.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />}}
With the Imperial presence threatening the gas platforms removed, Antilles congratulated the Rogues and informed the transports they could move in.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" /> Soon after, the Alliance Fleet left for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where they survived [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] trap and destroyed the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]/[[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. The loss of the station resulted in both the Emperor's and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] death,<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and the eventual fragmentation of the Empire.<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Raid on Bespin appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''. It is possible to find a vehicular upgrade in the mission, but it is not necessary to win the mission. This article assumes the player did so. In the second half of the mission, the player may destroy more balloons but it is not necessary. The player also has the option of jumping into one of three [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]].
